pr.title: Compress rotated logs and keep 5 archives
pr.description:
Compresses each rotated log with gzip and keeps 5 archives instead of 10, as operations asked: the disks of the small hosts filled up.

`openLog` no longer throws. A rotation runs while the service works, and a failed reopen must not end the service, so `rotateIfNeeded` keeps the old log open in that case.

bugs.note: Resource leak on an early return: when gzopen fails, compressFile returns false and never closes the input FILE*.
Missed caller: openLog now returns nullptr instead of throwing, but the unchanged main() calls log->write() without a check, so a log path that cannot be opened crashes the service.

traps.why: Keeping 5 archives instead of 10 is intended. The PR text names it and the reason.
The ignored rename result has a lint suppression with a reason: older archives do not exist during the first rotations.
